quote: Credit reporting shall not occur until after 180 days of the payment plan being inoperable.
explanation: This section on page 6 lets the hospital report you to credit bureaus 180 days after a payment plan fails. The same policy says on page 4 that the Medical Center will not furnish information about a medical debt to a credit reporting agency, so the policy contradicts itself. Ask which rule they follow.

quote: within 180 days of initial billing, report adverse information to a consumer credit reporting agency
explanation: The policy only bars credit reporting in the first 180 days after billing, which implies the hospital or its collectors may report you after that. California law no longer allows reporting hospital debt to credit bureaus at all.
